reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: 24.1 gives Customer an unrestricted affiliate/M&A successor assignment right on notice only, 24.2 restricts Vendor assignment (including by change of control) subject to Customer consent with a competitor bar, 24.3 applies a mutual not-unreasonably-withheld standard, and 24.4 expressly negates any Vendor termination, suspension, repricing, acceleration or service-reduction right on Customer's change of control — i.e. the preferred position, with no walk-away triggers.
No redline or counterparty comment is proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs and the deterministic carve-out check passes.

Only immaterial gap from the literal preferred wording (24.2 permits competitor assignment with Customer's consent rather than an absolute bar) is a minor sub-element properly left unflagged; the clause is favourable to us and should not be redlined.
